meaning:
1) pre-eminence, abundance, profit, superiority

elsewhere.note: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one…
